description: Make digital flashcards: add question/answer cards, study with flip mode, shuffle, and track what you know — saved on this device.

faqs.a: Add cards with a front (question) and back (answer), then press Study to flip through them one at a time.
Yes — your deck is saved in the browser's localStorage and restored when you return.
Press Shuffle deck in study mode to randomize the card order.
Mark cards as Known or Still learning while studying; the progress bar shows how much of the deck you know.
Yes — everything stays in your browser.

howto: Add flashcards with a front and back.
Press Study deck to enter flip mode.
Tap the card to flip, mark Known or Still learning, and track progress.
title: Flashcard Maker
